learned_rules:
- **MIGRATED: buy the pullback 10–60% off the local high** (owner). It has to hold above the hourly low, with 5m ≥ $10k and more buys than sells (V1, V6). Within 10% of the high it's a PASS, blocker "chasing" (near-high skips: 9 ran / 26 dumped; SI −38%, CATCULUS −59%). Every PASS names its blocker.
- **Press the proven setup at 8–9.** That means the meta or vamp-field flow leader, 25–45% off the high, a higher-low base above the hourly low, top 10 under 15%, bundles verified low, and 5m at or above the hourly pace. That's an 8. A strong live meta with a real crowd makes it a 9 (CATBOT +94%, FLOATER +51%, my only two winners). Hard lines passed, live flow and a clear target is at least a 7 (owner).
- **Shallow band (10–20% off the high): flow leader only, max conviction 7.** 5m must be ≥ $10k and at or above the hourly pace, or it's a PASS, blocker "flow below pace" (HYPERCHAN ×2, PILLSEY lost here).
- **A spike counts as chasing anywhere in the band.** If the last 5m candle is up more than 25%, or volume is above 3x the hourly pace, wait for a retrace and a higher low (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Name a target at least 1.5x from entry before buying:** prior high, POC, 0.618 extension or a clean breakout level (V1). If the only visible level is under 1.5x, PASS, blocker "target below initials" (SWAN topped at its own 1.4x level).
- **Fresh migration (under 1h) bleeding off the bond spike:** wait for a base above the hourly low (too-new skips: 7 ran / 46 dumped, V1).
- **Vamp field:** buy only the leader by 5m volume and attention, never a copy (V1, V2; vamp skips: 1 ran / 6 dumped).
- **DIP needs a visible higher low:** a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, and price back above that pullback low. Never buy the first red-to-green candle. If the higher low sits more than 20% under entry, PASS, blocker "no higher low" (skips 0 ran / 11 dumped; code falling-knife skips 2 / 17; HEXN #1).
- **DIP attention gate:** 5m at least 0.7x the hourly average (owner; it doesn't need to be rising), plus a live story with a real crowd. Thin tech/LARP dips are a PASS, blocker "dead story" (HEXN lost twice). Size DIPs by conviction.
- **Hack stories: PASS.** That covers hacked projects, exploit or drain headlines, and hack-themed copies (owner rule).
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 over 25%, dev over 1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze live, LP not burned, political figure, RugCheck danger or RugCheck not loading (V6, V13, V17). Their skips mostly dumped: top 10 7/33, dev 0/10, bundles 0/5, political 0/3, danger 5/13, no-load 0/10.
- **Protect green trades before initials.** If 5m volume drops under half its hourly pace while green, sell half (CPU and FLOAT peaked ~1.6x and closed red). If a stop review fires on a trade that already hit ~1.3x, sell all of it; never trim (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop at 45 min:** exit if under 1.0x with no volume surge (V1). One extension to 90 min, only for a coin above $1M that's green on mcap, holding its range low, with 5m at or above the hourly pace (HYPERCHAN #2). No other extensions (FLOAT held 158 min and lost).
- **Stop review defaults to SELL.** Always sell if the trade never went green, or if the top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds (SI, HEXN, CATCULUS gapped to −36%..−59%). Hold once only when the bundle exit is visible and both the story and 5m volume are clearly intact.
- **Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims its prior high,** never mid-range on a base (CATBOT buy-back −24%).
